title: Going from Place to Place
editorial: From Athens to Santorini, we regretfully flew Volotea as it was the cheapest airline. They charged us a stupid amount of money for not checking in advance, which we couldn’t because their damned website didn’t work! Unsurprisingly, they no longer fly that route. But the alternatives don’t appear to be much better.
You could opt for a ferry, which takes 5-8 hours depending on the number of stops. A one-way ticket would cost you between $40 to $60.
